svg.title: Zep / Graphiti: facts with dates, in a graph
svg.desc: Zep and Graphiti's architecture, with the running example. Writing: every message goes through four LLM steps (find entities, match them to stored ones, extract facts, compare with stored facts), 36 calls for ten messages. Memory: a graph of entities whose edges are facts with dates; the vegetarian edge was closed on 20 June 2026 and a pescatarian edge opened. Reading: a hybrid search with a 0.6 similarity floor returned nine facts, including the closed one; the pescatarian fact, Jonas's coeliac disease and Kreuzberg fell below the floor, so the answer missed the diet, gluten and the area.
